Purified GST-tagged PIN1 was captured on a CMS chip by GST capture kit, and the binding of compounds was measured by injecting various concentrations of compound at the flow rate of 30 μL/min, with contact time of 60 s and dissociation for 60 s by multicycle kinetics mode. The data were fitted with either a kinetic or steady state affinity model by the built-in software.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.05% (v/v) Surfactant P20, 1% (v/v) DMSO, pH 7.4
